tasks.name: Port tile/roof layering, compositing and lighting
tasks.evidence: Static MAP floor/roof PPM diagnostics plus original object bounds, unlit FRM top-level object sprite overlay and full CLI synthetic pixel export tested. Native true CE per-hex ordering, lighting, transparency, roof masking and gameplay view absent.

tasks.name: Build native Linux window, framebuffer scaling and input loop
tasks.evidence: Native SDL2 Linux sprite and MAP diagnostic windows, static roof toggle and optional animation playback. Base Linux build passed CI 39879473283; animation viewer build pending; no playable game loop.

tasks.name: Implement original hex projection and map scrolling
tasks.evidence: CE hex hit mask and inverse, floor/roof square projection, neighbor parity and tests passed Rust CI 39877712951; narrow C++ differential oracle added, CI pending; scrolling/collision absent.

tasks.name: Port pathfinding, collision and actor movement
tasks.evidence: CI-tested CE-style 2000-node path search with screen heuristic and turn cost, C++ numeric differential probe, MAP-derived direct/multihex collision and Linux read-only MAP route CLI integration test. No mutable actors, doors, animations or runtime movement.

tasks.name: Port map/elevation load and spatial exits
tasks.evidence: CI-tested MAP v19 variables, squares, serialized script and per-elevation object/inventory tables, PRO subtype lookup, immutable StaticScene composition and shared inspection/route commands. No live transitions, runtime map changes or state.
